title: Linear regression by gradient descent
summary: Mean squared error, its gradients for weights and bias, and a batch gradient descent loop that records the cost after each update.

mutants.bias_not_updated: Computes db but never updates the bias, so b stays at 0.
mutants.error_sign: Uses target minus prediction as the error, so the gradients point uphill.
mutants.history_before_update: Appends the cost before the update, so the history is one step behind.
mutants.missing_factor_two: Drops the factor of 2 from both gradients, so they are half the true gradient.
mutants.sequential_update: Updates w first and then computes db at the new w, so the bias step uses the wrong point.
